summary: Iteration 2 e2e verification of YourMovie's Stripe subscriptions, pre-roll ads, advanced browse filters, continue-watching, similar and premium hero autoplay. All 10 backend pytest cases pass (plans, checkout auth-gated + Stripe session creation + persisted transaction, payment status 200 & 404, media list with BBB video_url, similar (empty, no crash) + 404, watch-progress upsert + auth-gated). All frontend flows pass: pricing page shows 3 plans + monthly/yearly toggle, unauthenticated 'Choisir Standard' redirects to /login, authenticated click navigates to https://checkout.stripe.com/... URL. Home page shows premium-banner for non-premium user. WatchPage: pre-roll ads overlay renders, remove-ads-btn always visible, skip-ad-btn appears after 3s per ad (3 ads sequenced), after 3 ads video-player becomes visible (opacity=1) and ads overlay removed. Browse page has filter-genre, filter-year, filter-rating plus filter-all/movie/series/anime. MediaDetail page loads without crash despite empty Similar section (only 1 media).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 815 lines and starting to mix concerns (auth, media, reviews, favorites, uploads, Stripe, watch-progress, similar). Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, media.py, payments.py, watch.py) for maintainability >700 lines.
PreRollAds AD_DURATION=5s in production is short; ensure this is the intended UX. Skip becomes available at 3s of each ad which matches spec.
WatchPage.jsx onTimeUpdate throttles save via setTimeout 5s but does not clear on unmount cleanup — a stale timer could try to save after component unmounts (minor).

server.py /api/media/{media_id}/similar returns 404 for unknown id (good), but list_media has no server-side filtering for genre/year/minRating — currently done client-side in BrowsePage. Fine for small catalog but not scalable.
PricingPage subscribe() sets loading=null only on error; on success the page navigates away so it's fine, but if navigation is blocked (popup blocker) button stays in '...' state.
test_credentials: admin@yourmovies.app / Admin123! (admin, non-premium — used to trigger ads + non-premium banner)
seed_data_creation: 1 media exists (Big Buck Bunny id=m_0646e882a4d6). Watch progress row created by test for admin user; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 bugs (reviews 500 & media PUT 422) are already fixed in this build. Stripe checkout DOES NOT complete payment — only the redirect to https://checkout.stripe.com is verified. If future work needs to test premium flow end-to-end, either seed a user with premium_until in the future directly in MongoDB, or manually invoke _apply_paid_subscription via the payment_transactions.session_id path. PreRollAds ad_duration is 5s and skip appears at 3s; use ~3.5s waits between skip clicks. Homepage networkidle wait times out but domcontentloaded works fine — YouTube iframe polling keeps the network 'busy'.
